headline: Kuura Strand and Nevish Line Erupt as Central Front Clashes Persist
war_summary: Fresh tremors have upended the front lines over the past three hours, led by a sudden eruption in Kuura Strand where five strategic base exchanges took place around Faden Point and Menneen after earlier calm. Simultaneously, Nevish Line flared into active dispute, posting four rapid base transitions centered upon Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way. Weathered Expanse continues to bleed both sides white, logging three fresh base turnovers and over eight hundred casualties in two hours across the ruins of Spirit Watch and Frostmarch. Contested fighting also maintained its grip on Pari Peak, yielding three base changes near Pariah, while Linn of Mercy recorded another two transitions at the bitterly disputed Outwich Ranch. In contrast, action on Stlican Shelf subsided into quiet over the last two hours. Across Callahan’s Passage, Stonecradle, and Olavis Wake, casualty rates continue to accelerate dramatically under intense clashes, yet strategic ownership across these sectors remains locked.
